notes.title: 🍰Cute catgirls, succubus, vampires and other mystical inhabitants of Timeless Cafe🍰
notes.content:
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2649320/extras/800steam.gif[/img]

Cute mystical girls waiting for your instructions! You need to put together the best lineup to serve all the customers and win the heart of every waitress. More than 15 characters, many animated story scenes and beautiful events will be waiting for you ːcom_starː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649320/Timeless_Cafe/

[b]Timeless Cafe[/b]🍰 the ideological successor of Catgirls From My Sweet Dream with more complex deep gameplay and increased scale of events. Active gameplay will be combined with meditative storytelling and traditional for our projects Lofi soundtrack.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33018099/2c35434add2e4000c148e895b9e033abf2a3dfc2.png[/img]

We are currently in an active development phase, and many systems are still in testing.
For our small team this is the biggest project. Your support and ideas are very important to us. Please suggest ideas that you would like to see in our games further. 

We will keep you informed about the development and ask for your opinion on the details of this project. 

Thanks a lot for your support. Love you,
ːcom_loveː
